Frequently Asked Questions

Still you have any questions? Contact our Team via hello@squareup.com

01What services does SquareUp provide?

SquareUp offers design, engineering, and project management services. We help clients build websites, mobile apps, custom software, and end-to-end digital products.

02How can SquareUp help my business?

We turn ideas into usable digital products, improve user experience, modernize existing platforms, and help teams launch faster with a clear delivery process.

03What industries does SquareUp work with?

We work with startups, enterprise teams, publishers, non-profits, ecommerce companies, real estate, fitness, food delivery, and event-management businesses.

04How long does it take to complete a project?

Timelines depend on the size and complexity of the product. After discovery we provide a detailed roadmap with clear milestones and delivery dates.

05Do you offer ongoing support and maintenance?

Yes. We can continue to support, improve, and maintain your digital products after launch so your platform stays secure, fast, and scalable.

06Can you work with existing design or development frameworks?

Yes. We can adapt to your current stack, audit existing assets, and extend established design systems or codebases.

07How involved will I be in the project?

You stay involved through discovery sessions, feedback rounds, demos, and milestone reviews, while our team handles the day-to-day execution.

08Can you help with website or app updates?

Absolutely. We can plan and implement new features, redesign flows, improve performance, and refresh your product as your business grows.
